content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Mobile

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—secondary degree holders need five years of experience; bachelor's degree holders need three. Gather documentation of your work history and education now to streamline your application later.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Our trainers guide you through project-management frameworks, real-world case studies, and exam-focused content entirely online. You'll earn the 35 contact hours PMI requires—attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal education, create your PMI account and submit your PMP® application directly to the Project Management Institute. Include proof of your training hours and work experience. Pay PMI's exam fee to activate your eligibility window and reserve your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take Your Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides structured exam-preparation support to reinforce knowledge and build confidence. Study our review materials, practice assessments, and instructor guidance. Schedule your proctored exam at a location convenient to you and demonstrate your mastery of project-management competencies.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew. Pursue training, conferences, volunteer work, or practical project experience—all count toward renewal. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses designed to keep your skills current and your credential active.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
